DS-40: Total GHG emissions including LULUCF/LUCF exactly as the Party submitted them to the UNFCCC, on that Party’s own reporting guidelines and GWP set (UNFCCC Data Interface, snapshot of 2024-07-05). Non-Annex I Parties report only the years their national communications cover, and the figure is negative where reported removals exceed reported emissions. Points from an NDC document are that document's own inventory basis. The same year can appear more than once with different values; R3 keeps them side by side and never averages them.

ndc_assessment.vintage: First (I)NDC round, as assessed by WRI CAIT (2016). Not the latest submission.
ndc_assessment.summary: "Palestine intends to reduce its CO2eq emissions as set out in Table 1, conditional on receiving international support in the form of finance, technology transfer and capacity building. Independence Status quo 24.4% by 2040 relative to business-as-usual 12.8% by 2040 relative to business-as-usual Until independence is achieved, two scenarios are provided for the NDC: Independence scenario–by ending the Israeli occupation, Government of the State of Palestine achieves independence and is able to exercise full control over its resources. Status quo scenario – reflecting a continuation of the Israeli occupation of the State of Palestine. This does not mean that this is an acceptable situation."
ndc_assessment.ghg_target: 12.8% (status quo) to 24.4% (independence) reduction in GHG emissions by 2040 compared to the BAU scenario
ndc_assessment.sectors: Energy; industrial processes and product use; agriculture, forestry and other land use; waste.
ndc_assessment.$note: Third-party assessment of the first (I)NDC round. It is not merged into ndc.*, is not used by derive(), and does not appear on the dial as a target.

emissions_profile.$note: Headline totals are OWID only. OWID's CO₂ sub-totals are fossil/industrial CO₂ by fuel, not a full sectoral GHG breakdown, and do not sum to total_mtco2e. DS-05's rows are non-CO₂ gases only and are not comparable with the others; that is also why DS-05 is absent from series.observed, where a shorter curve would read as a disagreement rather than a difference of scope. by_source carries each source whole.

verdict.text: A later submission, NDC 3.0, was filed on 2026-08-31; it has not been read, so no figure here comes from it. 12 observed values are loaded from DS-02 (11), DS-40 (1). No implementation gap is reported: 11 observed years are loaded, but no NDC target emissions figure has been parsed, so there is nothing to measure the trend against. In the first NDC round, WRI's CAIT assessment recorded: 12.8% (status quo) to 24.4% (independence) reduction in GHG emissions by 2040 compared to the BAU scenario It was classed conditional. That is a 2016 assessment of an earlier submission, not the target above. Projected warming for 2080-2099 against 1995-2014 ranges from +1.32°C under SSP1-2.6 to +4.72°C under SSP5-8.5. These are model runs, not observations.
